title: 拉克丝 · 窗边星光
description: 金发拉克丝抱着软软的星形靠垫坐在窗边，身旁小杯热饮冒着暖气。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayons with broken edges, scribbled fill and visible warm paper tooth
art_direction.palette: sky blue, pale gold, ivory, peach pink, cream
art_direction.composition: Lux from League of Legends, recognizable as an adult blonde light mage with bright blue eyes and a sunny open smile. Original comfy costume adaptation: a sky-blue long-sleeved dress with an ivory collar, a short pale-blue cape, simple gold trim, opaque tights and rounded white boots. Seated comfortably on a low cushioned window bench, she hugs a large soft yellow star-shaped cushion against her chest. One small blue mug of hot cocoa sits safely on a side stool, not held over the cushion. Three tiny warm gold motes of light drift by the window like friendly fireflies, no attack or magical blast. Whole body in a relaxed three-quarter view, feet gently tucked beside the bench. One curved window, peach curtains and a little paper-white negative space. Emphasize chunky wax strokes, soft round cheeks and warm blue-gold harmony. No weapon, staff, armor battle or copied official pose.

visual_qa.method: six-image compressed JPEG contact sheet review, 1280x900
